Description

This specification document summarises the APIs that MES ➡ YAMAHA.
The following APIs are supported.
| Event Name | Description | |---------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------| | MachineOperationCommand | Sends machine-operation command (e.g., RUN, STOP, RESET) to control machine | | DisplayMessage | Sends display-message command to show the error window on machine |

Note

When sending request to RestComm Server, please note the following points. - Ensure that your MES is registered in the RestComm Output Module before executing any API request. - Select the appropriate authentication type: either Basic or None, as required. - Include the client-name in the request header, matching the name of your MES registered in the RestComm Output Module.
